annotations.title: Search crypto tax tools for Swedish K4

description: Search crypto tax software for Swedish K4 reporting (Divly, Koinly, CoinTracking). Use this when a user asks which tool can calculate crypto gains or produce K4 underlay for Skatteverket. Returns structured records: name, category, the tool's own description and a link. For the actual K4 rules call list_guides then get_guide (Swedish text with Skatteverket sources). Empty query lists all.

query.description: Optional filter: tool name or keyword (e.g. 'koinly', 'K4'). Empty returns all.
